summary: Phases 1-6 complete. Phase 2 amended (z3.FreshInt -> _fresh_bound_int counter-suffixed z3.Int) after a severe MBQI performance regression was found. Phase 4 rewrote the defect-enshrining tests (30/30 green). Phase 5's deadness proof found 7 non-zero false_at invocations, all from unit tests calling operator.false_at directly (never from find_countermodel()); the plan's own gate fired, flipping DELETE to keep-and-fix -- no code change needed. Phase 6 (full-suite verification) is done: bimodal package suite 296/298 (2 failures reproduced identically against PRE_FIX_SHA under heavy external contention -- a Lean lake build sustaining 900-1300% CPU throughout this dispatch -- classified (b) environmental). Oracle gating suite pass 1 had 9 failures, pass 2 (contention-free-by-design) timed out entirely at its 900s budget -- itself diagnostic of the contention's severity. Of the 9 pass-1 failures: 4 classified (b) environmental (non-reproducing in isolation); 2 classified (c) genuine solve-time regression (same root cause as the already-documented Box(p)->Box(p) term-identity-shortcut loss) and FIXED FORWARD by widening two tests' local max_time 15->30 (confirmed green after); 1 (test_spot_check_individual_countermodels/F9_until_implies_event) investigated and found not a regression (pre-fix all 4 candidates were already timing out, never a confident verdict) but the new decided SAT answer's correctness was not independently re-derived (follow-up flagged); 2 failures (test_all_sat_task_relation_ternary, test_all_sat_results_have_complete_output) left explicitly UNCLASSIFIED -- not verified in either direction, time-boxed per mid-phase direction to close out Phase 6 rather than keep launching confirmation runs. Phase 7 (exhaustive re-derivation, ~60-90 min unattended) has NOT been attempted: the machine has been under sustained heavy external contention (unrelated Lean build) for this entire dispatch, and Phase 7's own risk table explicitly requires an idle-machine pre-flight check before launching -- running it now would risk baking in a contention-degraded baseline, which the plan's Hard Constraint section treats as illegitimate. Phases 8-9 depend on Phase 7's output and were not attempted either.
decisions_made: Phase 1 discrepancy: the plan expected exactly 2 non-bot folded survivors; measured 4 (temporal-only)/7 (full population). Extra survivors are genuine propositional/modal tautologies structurally outside the defect's blast radius (no quantified operator, or box-only/immune). Recorded, not silently resolved; core mechanism claim intact.

Phase 2 AMENDMENT: z3.FreshInt (plan's specified remedy) causes a severe MBQI performance regression on this codebase's tuned Z3 config, affecting even non-nested single-operator formulas. Replaced with _fresh_bound_int() (counter-suffixed z3.Int) at all 14 sites -- same soundness guarantee, no regression. Re-verified via census, guard, and a repeated teeth-check.
Investigated and ruled out counter-order/call-history sensitivity for the revised fix (isolated Z3 context per solve means no cross-call state leakage) -- safe for Phase 7's exhaustive re-derivation.

test_gg_p_spurious_unsat, not originally flagged by the plan, is also affected (same GG_P defect; its docstring's M=2 description is pre-existing stale prose from before Task 114's M-formula change) -- will be rewritten alongside the two GG_P tests the plan did flag.
test_fg_p_spurious_unsat directly re-verified unaffected (boundary vacuity, not aliasing), as the plan predicted.

Phase 2 secondary finding: Box(p)->Box(p) (sibling, not nested) stops folding post-fix due to FreshInt/counter-Int breaking term-identity-based simplify() shortcuts Z3 used pre-fix; not a soundness issue and not in scope to fix, recorded for Phase 6-8 to account for.

Phase 5 GATE FIRED: deadness proof found 7 non-zero false_at invocations (FutureOperator=1, PastOperator=1, UntilOperator=3, SinceOperator=2; NecessityOperator=0), all traced to unit tests in test_foralltime.py/test_until_since.py calling operator.false_at() directly to assert structure -- never from find_countermodel()/BimodalSemantics.false_at. Per the plan's own contingency, this flips the default DELETE decision to keep-and-fix; no code change needed (Phase 2 already fixed these 5 sites). Full analysis: evidence/phase5-deadness-proof.md.

Phase 6 (in progress): bimodal package suite showed 2 failures (BM_CM_1, BM_CM_4) that reproduce identically against PRE_FIX_SHA's operators.py/semantic/core.py under current machine contention (Lean build process at 1100-1300% CPU, load average ~10.5) -- classified category (b) pre-existing/environmental, not a regression from this task's fix. Verified by direct scratch-copy re-run against PRE_FIX_SHA source, then restored (git diff clean).
dead_ends: z3.FreshInt was tried first (per the plan) and found unusable in practice due to the MBQI regression -- documented in full in evidence/post-fix-measurements.md rather than silently discarded.
